intro: We provide architectural and interior design services from the first concept to the finished building. One studio carries the project through design, BIM coordination, permits and construction, so nothing gets lost between phases.

phases.title: Conceptual & Schematic Design
phases.text: We translate your vision into a viable spatial strategy. This phase involves rigorous site analysis, zoning evaluations, and the development of preliminary architectural concepts. We focus on optimizing spatial planning, massing, and functional relationships to establish a solid foundation for the project's development.

items.title: Site Context Analysis
items.text: Evaluating topography, environmental conditions, and zoning regulations to inform the optimal design strategy.

items.title: Spatial Programming
items.text: Defining functional requirements and establishing highly efficient layouts for all project spaces.

items.title: Massing and Form Generation
items.text: Developing early 3D models to explore volumetric relationships and establish the architectural identity.

phases.title: Design Development & BIM Modeling
phases.text: Transitioning from concept to reality, we refine the architectural design through advanced Building Information Modeling (BIM). We finalize material selections, integrate structural and MEP (Mechanical, Electrical, and Plumbing) systems, and conduct comprehensive clash detection to resolve potential conflicts before they reach the construction site.

items.title: Advanced 3D Integration
items.text: Utilizing intelligent Building Information Modeling (BIM) to coordinate architecture, structure, and MEP systems.

items.title: Material Specification
items.text: Selecting finishes and systems that meet aesthetic goals while satisfying structural and budgetary constraints.

items.title: Proactive Clash Detection
items.text: Identifying and resolving spatial conflicts between engineering disciplines before construction begins.

phases.title: Construction Documents & Engineering
phases.text: We produce detailed construction documentation: drawings, specifications and schedules that contractors can price and build from. Careful detailing means more accurate bids, fewer variations on site and documents that meet the applicable building codes.

items.title: Detailed Arch. Drawings
items.text: Producing precise floor plans, sections, and elevations required for accurate contractor bidding.

items.title: Custom Construction Details
items.text: Developing specialized technical drawings for complex structural junctions, thermal envelopes, and waterproofing.

items.title: Permit Documentation
items.text: Preparing documentation that meets the applicable building codes and supports the permit process, in Serbia through the CEOP e-permit system.

phases.title: Construction Administration & Oversight
phases.text: Our involvement continues on the construction site to protect your investment. We act as your technical representatives, conducting regular site inspections, reviewing contractor submittals, and managing change orders. We ensure that the project is executed exactly to our specifications, maintaining quality, budget, and schedule.

items.title: On-Site Quality Control
items.text: Conducting systematic site inspections to ensure contractors strictly follow the approved technical documentation.

items.title: Submittal and RFI Management
items.text: Evaluating contractor shop drawings, material samples, and rapidly resolving technical requests for information.

items.title: Cost and Change Control
items.text: Tracking construction progress and reviewing change orders, so delays and extra costs are caught before they grow.

phases.title: Interior Architecture & Custom Detailing
phases.text: We extend our architectural vision into the interior environment. Our services include bespoke millwork design, material curation, and lighting design. We ensure a seamless transition between the exterior envelope and the interior spaces, creating cohesive and highly functional environments.

items.title: Bespoke Millwork Design
items.text: Engineering custom cabinetry and built-in elements perfectly tailored to the specific spatial geometry.

items.title: Lighting and Acoustic Strategies
items.text: Developing integrated lighting plans and specifying acoustic treatments to maximize environmental comfort.

items.title: Material Curation
items.text: Sourcing high-quality interior finishes, fixtures, and hardware that seamlessly align with the exterior architectural vision.

phases.title: Feasibility Studies & Master Planning
phases.text: For large-scale developments, we provide strategic master planning and feasibility analysis. We evaluate site potential, assess regulatory constraints, and develop long-term spatial strategies that maximize land value and guide future phases of development.

items.title: Site Potential Evaluation
items.text: Assessing physical constraints and regulatory frameworks to determine the maximum development capacity of a plot.

items.title: Yield and Density Analysis
items.text: Calculating buildable areas and optimizing spatial distribution to ensure the project is financially viable.

items.title: Long-Term Phasing Strategies
items.text: Structuring large-scale developments into logical stages to optimize capital investment and manage risk.
